annual_fact_rule: Income-statement factors use annual 10-K, 20-F, or 40-F facts with 250-450 day reporting periods. These are latest-known annual fundamentals, not rolling TTM.
availability_rule: Every SEC fact is joined only when its conservative available_date is less than or equal to the rebalance date.
gross_profitability_warning: Gross-profit coverage is materially lower than other quality inputs and is treated as a secondary component.

methodology.book_to_market: Latest known positive annual stockholders equity divided by point-in-time market cap.
methodology.earnings_yield: Latest known annual net income divided by point-in-time market cap.
methodology.gross_profitability: Latest known annual gross profit divided by assets.
methodology.leverage: Latest known annual liabilities divided by assets.
methodology.market_cap: Raw historical close multiplied by the latest SEC-reported shares outstanding known as of the rebalance date.
methodology.operating_profitability: Latest known annual operating income divided by assets.
methodology.roa: Latest known annual net income divided by latest known annual assets.
methodology.roe: Latest known annual net income divided by latest known positive annual stockholders equity.

price_rule: Raw close is used for market-cap construction because SEC shares outstanding are unadjusted actual shares. Adjusted close is not used for market capitalization.
